Class EMFContainmentReferenceSetter

java.lang.Object
io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator.EMFConfigurableFeatureSetter<org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EReference, org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EReference, org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject>
io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator.EMFInstanceCreatorFeatureSetter<org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EReference>
io.github.lorenzobettini.emfmodelgenerator.EMFContainmentReferenceSetter
public class EMFContainmentReferenceSetter extends EMFInstanceCreatorFeatureSetter<org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EReference>
Responsible for setting containment reference values on EMF EObjects. This class handles both single-valued and multi-valued containment references, creating appropriate EObjects based on the reference's type. The created EObjects are returned as a collection.
Author:
Lorenzo Bettini

  • Method Details

    • setContainmentReference

      public Collection<org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject> setContainmentReference(org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EObject owner, org.eclipse.emf.ecore.EReference reference)
      Set the containment reference on the given owner EObject. For setting the containment reference, new EObjects are created. For creating the EObjects, instantiable subclasses of the reference type are selected using the configured strategy (by default, round-robin).
      Parameters:
      owner - the EObject owning the reference
      reference - the assumed containment EReference to set (its type is assumed to be in a resource, which is assumed to be in a resource set)
      Returns:
      a collection of created EObjects assigned to the containment reference
